title: API Client is the managed outbound execution plane
summary: API Client is provider-neutral outbound execution with declarative route requirements, managed egress sessions, WLU/rate admission, completion routing and native HTTPS; it is not a curl wrapper.
invariants: ApiRequest describes work independently from transport implementation.
ApiRouteRequirement is declarative and independent of HTTP semantics.
Origin/owner node, execution node and egress node are distinct identities.
Country, VPN, network, egress class and required-tag constraints are hard eligibility requirements, never soft preferences.
Session reservation is explicit and releasable.
Completion uses registered routing/callback seams rather than arbitrary callback URLs supplied by untrusted request data.
Native transport must fail closed on TLS/HTTP errors and must not shell out to curl.
procedure: Resolve route requirements before transport side effects.
Perform WLU/rate admission after route/session resolution.
Return completion through the owning session/callback seam.

provenance.claim: API Client is provider-neutral and separates route/session/admission/transport responsibilities.
v0.3 supplies native HTTPS through RxSock and Foreign Runtime/OpenSSL with fail-closed transport behaviour.
